qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Extreme enterprise switching costs and network effects across M365, Azure, Windows, and enterprise identity (Active Directory) create deep workflow lock-in that competitors cannot replicate without massive switching friction. Empirically proven by 10-year median GAAP ROIC >34%, operating margins expanding from ~30% to >46%, and recurring 9-15% M365 E3/E5 pricing increases with virtually zero enterprise churn. Primary erosion threats: open-source AI tooling bypassing proprietary enterprise software layers, escalating AI datacenter capex driving heavy D&A margin drag, and antitrust/bundling scrutiny.
